integrity: Analytical proof supplied with a standalone finite checker. No independent scientific audit or external certification is claimed. Date denotes the primary Yan–Hunt publication verified by the publisher; the earlier Yin beta-model antecedent is cited by year only because its first-public calendar day was not verified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns instantaneous Yan–Hunt cardinal-temperature response under a fixed equal-duration two-level temperature mean. Acclimation, differing day/night physiology, thermal costs, and dynamical biomass feedback are excluded; full-temperature boundary policies may be outside empirical calibration. Prior beta-response research and Jensen effects are known, and historical priority over generic symmetric two-point moment optimizations is not established by absence of hits.
title: A tricritical amplitude-optimization law for two-temperature cardinal plant responses
